reason: The arrays are coated in grit, so I’ll make a cleaning implement from the fabric and steel first.
expectation: I expect a fabric-covered cleaning tool, though its exact form is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: Placing the solar supply at the arrays may help restore power, but cleaning them seems like the first priority.

effect: The pad is ready to remove loose dust from the arrays.
reaction: The soft, clean cloth makes physical sense for avoiding scratches.
reason: Place the cleaning pad at the dusty arrays so it can be used there.
expectation: I expect this to position the pad for cleaning; it may need another action to restore power.

alternatives.reason: The solar supply also needs to be at the arrays, but I want the cleaning tool in place first.

effect: The pad is positioned at the arrays, enabling the cleaning combination.
reaction: The placement is straightforward, though it is a separate preparation step.
reason: Use the pad on the solar supply to clear the dust and restore power.
expectation: I expect the panels to be cleaned and solar power to become available again, though additional steps may be needed.

effect: The cleaned arrays are supplying power again, restoring the lamps and atmospheric processor.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the growing room and oxygen supply recover together.
reason: Restore the drained water line now that power is available.
expectation: I expect the exterior line to resume heating and water service, though it may need further preparation.

alternatives.reason: The return plant also needs restarting, but restoring water seems more immediately useful.

effect: The well line is warmed, primed and running, and the farm circuit is back to normal. The remaining goal is to resume production.
reaction: Warming and checking the line before opening the inlet makes the restart feel sensible.
reason: Restart the return plant with restored solar power; it is the only offered action for resuming production.
expectation: I expect the plant to leave storm mode and resume producing propellant, though it may need further steps.

effect: Power and cooling are restored to the plant, but its feed remains closed until water is available.
reaction: The staged restart makes sense after the storm shutdown.
reason: Connect the primed water line to the powered plant; it is the only offered action toward resuming production.
expectation: I expect the water circuit to become available and propellant production to resume, though further steps may be needed.

effect: The restored water circuit let the plant complete its checks and replace the propellant lost during the storm; the chapter is complete.
reaction: The connected, staged restart was a satisfying conclusion.

mostWorthwhile.text: Restarting the water line was most worthwhile: warming and checking it before opening the inlet made the recovery physically understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the pad before using it felt like a routine extra step rather than a meaningful decision.

surprise.text: The plant restored controls and cooling first but kept its feed closed until the water circuit was ready; that clarified how the restart was sequenced.

arbitrary.text: The separate pad placement felt somewhat mechanical, although its purpose was clear.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see what happens with the recovered samples and return journey; this chapter made the station's interdependent systems feel consequential.
